title.suggested: Prize Fighters Jailed or in Exile; Allen Said to Be in Australia

summary.suggested: The St. Louis Evening Dispatch said the age was not good for prize fighters: Coburn and Goss were in prison, Mace a fugitive in Canada, Clark and Weeden jailed in New Jersey, and Tom Allen had gone to Australia.

metadata.notes: Masthead: St. Louis Dispatch, Thursday Evening, March 29, 1877. Filed as the St. Louis Evening Dispatch before 1878-12.

facts.fact: The Dispatch reported that Allen had gone to Australia (other papers that month placed him in Canada)

notes: The current summary mentions a 'Goss fight controversy' that is not in the text. The Australia claim conflicts with articles 594 and 596 (Canada) and 597 (Halifax, sailing for England).
